name: stri_trans_isnfkc
title: Test whether strings are in NFKC

origin.description: Report whether each string is already in NFKC.
origin.details: TRUE when the string is already in NFKC. The two letters fi are TRUE. The fi ligature is FALSE. An empty string is TRUE. A missing value stays missing.
origin.value: A logical vector of the same length as str.
origin.example:
cat(paste0("stri_trans_isnfkc of the fi ligature returns ", stri_trans_isnfkc("ﬁ"), ".
"))

translation.description: Report whether each string is already in NFKC.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list or tuple of those.

translation.details: unicodedata.is_normalized with NFKC matches this test. An empty string is True. NA stays NA.
translation.value: True or False, or a list of those values when str is a list or tuple.
translation.example:
from stringi.normalize import stri_trans_isnfkc
print(f"stri_trans_isnfkc of the fi ligature returns {stri_trans_isnfkc('ﬁ')}.")
